name: ignores-research
description: Prices and services are right, but the proposal sells a landing page and an AI assistant and ignores the two high-impact problems the research found (no online ordering, no Google profile) without saying why. Only the reviewer can judge the fit; the code flags the landing page as absent from the research.
brief: Gina's Bakery, artisan bakery in Bondi. Site: https://ginas-bakery.example/. They take orders through Instagram DMs and want online orders.

proposal.title: Gina's Bakery: a page that answers for you
proposal.summary: Your customers ask the same questions every day on Instagram. We propose a new landing page and an AI assistant that answers hours, menu and allergen questions around the clock.
proposal.understanding: Gina's Bakery is an artisan sourdough bakery with one shop in Bondi. The website shows the menu and the hours and Instagram is active. Customers write with questions and orders all day.
objectives: Answer customer questions without a person on Instagram
A page that looks good on a phone

scope.name: Landing page
scope.description: One page, mobile first, with the menu, the hours, the map and a contact form.

scope.name: AI assistant
scope.service: AI assistant on the site or WhatsApp
scope.description: Answers questions about hours, menu and allergens, 24/7, on the page and on WhatsApp.
deliverables: Assistant trained on your menu and FAQs

timeline.needs_from_client: Menu, hours, the questions you get most

investment.payment_terms: 50% to start, 50% on delivery. Two rounds of changes included.

assumptions: The current menu stays as it is
questions_for_client: Which questions do you get most on Instagram?

findings.note: The brief asks for online orders and the research marks it and the Google profile as high impact; the proposal leaves both out without a reason.
The research did not suggest a landing page.
